summary: Dedicated: SSE disconnects under load during burst (customers see truncated streams)
description: During a burst test on Dedicated pool, client receives partial streaming chunks then TCP close. Customer reports it happens when concurrency > ~120. Non-streaming requests succeed. They are using SSE via SDK.
comments: Support (Camila): Customer provided Grafana screenshot showing connection resets line up with autoscaler events.
SRE (David): Found HPA scaling triggered frequent pod rotations; some in-flight SSE streams lost when gateway pods drained.
Eng: Adjusted preStop + terminationGracePeriodSeconds for gateway in this dedicated cluster; enabled connection draining for SSE.
Support: Customer reran burst test; no disconnects observed up to 200 concurrency. Closing as resolved.
